Lana Swanson

Twenty-five years in enterprise technology taught me how to read a market, structure a complex deal, and cut through noise to what actually matters. I brought all of that to real estate.

I live and work in La Jolla. I know which streets flood in January, which neighborhoods are quietly appreciating, and which listings are priced to move versus priced to hope. That's the difference between someone who looks up information and someone who just knows it.

I work with buyers and sellers across all seven La Jolla neighborhoods — Bird Rock, The Village, La Jolla Shores, Muirlands, Mount Soledad, Windansea, and Country Club — as well as Del Mar, Solana Beach, and greater San Diego County.

I'm with Coldwell Banker Realty at 888 Prospect St in La Jolla — and yes, I answer my phone.
